## Orpheus TTS API

Orpheus TTS is a text-to-speech model by Canopy Labs, available on the Venice API as `tts-orpheus`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Orpheus TTS is Canopy Labs' open-weight speech model, built on Llama 3B for natural, emotive delivery. It offers 8 voices and returns WAV audio.

### Orpheus TTS API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tts-orpheus` | Standard | Private | $62.50 / 1M chars |

### Orpheus TTS specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Canopy Labs |
| Released | Apr 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Voices | 8 |
| Formats | wav |

### How to use the Orpheus TTS API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/speech` with `"model": "tts-orpheus"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "tts-orpheus",
    "input": "Private AI for everyone.",
    "voice": "dan",
    "response_format": "mp3"
  }' --output speech.mp3
```
